answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce resource: each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a unique verified kernel of identity prior to transacting. Duplicate identities forfeit their bond, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits, making attacks economically irrational. Reputation then accrues like saffron harvested from a shared orchard, where every plot is costly to plant and each harvest is publicly tracked, so cheap pseudonyms yield no yield and honest agents compound trust. The sa0001 deployment anchors trust at iiwSH8Aqvc.
